decisions.reason: Because D survived the firm's early post-launch cull and is a platform closely tied to its GIS consulting core, management would likely see it as meeting aspiration levels or worth supporting with available slack.

E remained marketed across 2018 and 2019 and fits the firm's solution portfolio, but as a standalone mobile field product it likely faces somewhat higher pressure if results fall short of aspirations.

The 2019 version update for F suggests active refinement and acceptable feedback relative to aspirations, though as a narrower extension it is still somewhat easier to drop than a core platform product.
